description:
Use this when the user asks how much index funds may need to buy of a stock joining an index, or its estimated weight there. Estimates with their inputs, not a price forecast or FII flows.

Returns the estimated weight and the rupees, share of free float and days of median traded value it implies for money tracking the index, each input with its date and source; `not_computed` names what is missing. `query` is an NSE symbol, ISIN or BSE code; `index` an id or name. `tracking_assets` replaces the stored figure, in full units of `tracking_assets_currency` (default INR). For daily FII and DII flows use get_market_fii_dii_flow; for past events, get_index_event_study.

index.description: Index id, display name or the provider's name, e.g. msci:india_standard, Nifty 50 or India Standard (case-insensitive).
index.title: Index

query.description: One company: NSE symbol, ISIN or BSE code, e.g. TCS, INE467B01029 or 532540. Always send it as `query` (not `symbol`).
query.title: Query

name: estimate_index_flow
title: Index change flow estimate
